tool.name: ParaFEM Transient Thermal Solver
tool.description: Solve 3D transient heat conduction with IC/restart support (GDPS solver)
tool.command: mkdir -p run && cd run && cp '$d_file' job.d && cp '$bnd_file' job.bnd && cp '$fix_file' job.fix && cp '$dat_file' job.dat && cp '$mat_file' job.mat && #if $ic_type.mode == "file": cp '$ic_type.ini_file' job.ini && echo "2" > job.ctrl && echo "job.ini" >> job.ctrl && #elif $ic_type.mode == "restart": cp '$ic_type.chk_file' job.chk && echo "3" > job.ctrl && echo "job.chk" >> job.ctrl && #else: echo "1" > job.ctrl && #end if mpirun -np \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1} gdps_thermal_transient job 2>&1; RC=\$?; if [ -f job.res ]; then mv job.res '$output_res'; else echo "Solver produced no .res output (exit code \${RC})" > '$output_res'; fi; if [ -f job.chk ]; then mv job.chk '$output_chk'; fi; if ls job.ensi.* 1>/dev/null 2>&1; then tar czf '$output_ensi' job.ensi.*; else tar czf '$output_ensi' --files-from /dev/null; fi; exit \${RC}

param.name: d_file
param.label: Mesh geometry (.d)
param.help: Mesh file with nodal coordinates and element connectivity

param.name: fix_file
param.label: Fixed freedoms (.fix)
param.help: Prescribed temperature values from BC generator

param.name: dat_file
param.label: Control data (.dat)
param.help: Solver control parameters from BC generator

param.name: mat_file
param.label: Material properties (.mat)
param.help: Material thermal properties (kx, ky, kz, rho, cp) from BC generator

tool.help:
Solves 3D transient heat conduction using the GDPS transient thermal solver.
Solver: Implicit theta time integration with Preconditioned Conjugate Gradient (PCG) for the spatial solve at each time step. Uses 8-node hexahedral elements.
Initial Conditions: - Uniform: Uses the 'val0' value from the .dat file as the starting temperature for all nodes. - From .ini file: Reads per-node temperatures from a text file (produced by Extract IC tool). - Restart: Continues a previous simulation from a binary checkpoint (.chk) file.
Outputs: - .res: text summary with time, temperature at monitor node, and PCG iterations per step. - .ensi.tar.gz: EnSight Gold scalar fields (NDTTR-NNNNNN) for each output timestep. - .chk: binary checkpoint file for subsequent restarts.
The number of MPI processes is controlled by GALAXY_SLOTS.
